blurb: Guests can play on an 18-hole par 3 golf course, try foot golf which combines soccer and golf, enjoy mini golf and batting cages at Mountain View Adventure Center, and rent various park district facilities for events. The golf course is open seasonally from April through November, weather permitting. Group outings and parties are available with food packages and pavilion rentals.
